case_title: HU ZHOU VS. IAN MURRAY ET AL

ORDER CASE CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT: PENDING SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-02-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO AUG-17-2021 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF HU ZHOU IS PRESENT VIA ZOOM. DEFENDANT IAN MURRAY IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT EMILLIO MESA IS PRESENT. DEFENDANTS WAIVE SERVICE. COURT DISCLOSURE IS MADE. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $1250.00 TO THE PLAINTIFF BY PAYPAL. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE AUG-17TH HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. CORRECTED NOTICE SENT TO PARTIES ON AUG-04-2021. DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING, HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG PRESENTED DISCLOSURE, AND LITIGATE(S)DID NOT OBJECT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE. CASE SETTLED. PLAINTIFF HU ZHOU, IS PRESENT VIA ZOOM. DEFENDANTS EMILLIO MESA AND IAN MURRAY IS PRESENT. PARTIES STATE THAT PAYMENT ON THE JUDGMENT HAS BEEN MADE. DEFENDANT SHOWS TO THE COURT A PAYPAL RECEIPT/TRANSCATION SHOWING THAT PAYMENT WAS MADE TO PLAINTIFF ZHOU FOR THE AMOUNT OF $1,250.00. ORDER CASE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. CASE SETTLED.
CORRESPONDENCE -PLACED IN FILE RECEIVED BY PLAINTIFF ZHOU, HU AKA "JACK"

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-17-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO AUG-31-2021 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF HU ZHOU IS PRESENT VIA ZOOM. DEFENDANT IAN MURRAY AND EMILLIO MESA ARE NOT PRESENT. COURT DISCLOSURE REGARDING CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS IS MADE. PLAINTIFF INFORMS THE COURT THAT THE DEFENDANT'S PAYPAL OF THE $1250.00 SETTLEMENT APEPARS TO HAVE BEEN SENT AS A SERVICE/GOODS VS. A FRIEND OR FAMILY PAYMENT. THE SERVICE/GOOD PAYPAL OPTION RESULTED IN A $36.13 FEE CHARGED TO PLAINTIFF, THEREBY REDUCING THE SETTLEMENT AMOUNT TO $1,213.87. PLAINTIFF SHARED HIS SCREEN WITH THE COURT AND THE COURT INSTRUCTED THE PLAINTIFF TO REFUND THE AUGUST 5, 2021 PAYMENT WITH A NOTE EXPLAINING WHY IT WAS REFUNDED AND REQUESTING THE SETTLEMENT AMOUNT BE RESENT AS A FRIEND/FAMILY. A PROGRESS REPORT DATE IS SET. NO APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED IF PAYMENT IS MADE AS AGREED AND. IF NO APPEARANCE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
